_about: Junon Colosseum courses. tools/apply_course_design.py writes these into junon-arena.json; edit here, then run it. Rounds are native Combat Simulator rounds (terVR_COL30_<id> with POS_COL30_<id>): new EnemyTerritory rows hang every simulator battle, so every round reuses a native territory and its spawn positions unchanged. Rewards: the first clear grants first_clear once; every clear after that draws one entry of pool by weight (per mille), the game's own RewardRandom mechanism. Every reward is a materia from approved_materia at its maximum level.
_battle: Owner design: fights happen in the Junon arena beside the foyer, as Musclehead's do in the Gold Saucer. mode arena uses the colosseum menu (4,0,5) and the arena level/territory named here; mode simulator uses the game's own VR arena and the simulator menu (4,1,5), proven live 2026-11-09 (AQ/AR) but not the owner's design. Simulator-type rows crash the colosseum menu (AM/AN/AO).

_rewards: Owner's final table, 2026-11-10: rewards are themed to their course names. The first clear grants first_clear once; every later clear draws one pool entry by weight (per mille, equal shares). Every reward is a materia at its maximum level (max_level is the game's Materia LvMax; names from its text). Every materia on owner_materia must stay winnable from some course; the board shows one reward, so each course's text lists its repeat-clear materia (added by tools/apply_course_design.py).

modifiers.text: Rivals: every enemy starts each round with a random Mako infusion.
Rally: whenever an enemy falls, every surviving enemy gains a random Mako infusion.
Riot rush: enemies are hasted all course.
Bloodlust: your fighters are berserk all course, dealing and taking more damage.
Hall of mirrors: enemies reflect spells for the first 60 seconds of each round.
Twisted weaknesses: enemies absorb the elements they were weak to.
Arms race: for every Mako infusion you take, the enemy gains one too for the rest of the course.
Time trap: every 30 seconds, one of your fighters is stopped.
Short rest: between rounds your fighters recover only 20% HP and 15% MP.
Slim pickings: only two Mako infusions to choose from.
Second wind: every enemy recovers to half health once, the first time it drops below 20% HP.
Darkside: every round your fighters start in Darkside: abilities hit 20% harder but cost 5% HP each.
Encore: a tenth round with two bosses at once.

_modifiers: Owner 2026-11-10: creative rules over HP and damage: Toad drill, Hall of mirrors, Bloodlust (Berserk), Darkside (BSC_Dark, the status the Darkside ability gives: "あんこく"), Mirror match (replaced by Arms race on 2026-11-11), Time trap. The second enemy boon, the stagger rule and Heavy hitters were dropped. Owner 2026-11-10 (after playtest): Toad drill was not fun; course 3 is now Riot rush (enemies hasted). Owner 2026-11-10 (reorder): from course 2, Rivals, Tough hides, Riot rush, Bloodlust, Hall of mirrors, Twisted weaknesses, Mirror match, Time trap, Wounded, Slim pickings, Second wind, Darkside, Encore. Owner 2026-11-11: Short rest replaces Wounded (start each round at no more than 75% HP) on course 10: vanilla rounds restore 50% HP and 30% MP between rounds; under Short rest a fighter starts a round with at most what it ended its last round with plus 20% of its max HP and 15% of its max MP (kind party_recovery, buffwheel.lua). Owner 2026-11-11: Arms race replaces Mirror match on course 8, because most infusions (materia, accessories, abilities, actions) mean nothing on an enemy: for every infusion the player takes (refusals do not count), the enemies gain one random enemy boon from enemy_boons (the Rivals pool) for the rest of the course, on every enemy (kind arms_race, buffwheel.lua). 2026-11-11 (live bug, course 12): Second wind gave every enemy BSC_Reraise, and the enemies lay dead without rising while the battle never ended, so courses 12-14 could not be cleared. It now gives no status: kind second_wind, the first time the once-a-second tick sees an enemy standing below 'below' % HP it is restored to 'to' % HP, once per enemy (buffwheel.lua). An enemy taken from above the threshold to 0 between two ticks simply dies. 2026-11-11 (research): Darkside's HP cost and potency belong to the Darkside materia M_COM_106 (EffectType 16 UseAbilityDarkness; Lv 5: 5% HP per ability, +20% potency; magic unaffected), not to the BSC_Dark status (1.2 multipliers only), so the status alone cost no HP live. The modifier now also names the materia and its carrier Equipment row (E_ACC_7106, a clone of HP Up Materia Earrings naming M_COM_106; apply_buff_wheel.carrier_for): buffwheel.lua asks the native helper for that row for the whole party for the course (junon-infusions.req, before the run's infusion accessories), and BSC_Dark is still given at every round's start to turn Darkside on. The materia brings the Darkside command too; owner 2026-11-11: a fighter may use it to switch Darkside off, and it comes back at the next round's start (no mid-round re-apply). 2026-11-11 (live): neither the status nor the carrier cost any HP (owner by hand; Yuffie with the Darkside command, frozen enemies), so 'hp_cost' (5, the materia's own 5% at every level) makes buffwheel.lua charge it: 5% of max HP, never below 1 HP, for each use of an ability in data/darkside-abilities.json (weapon and folio abilities and the attack command materia, from the vanilla BattleAbility table; tools/extract_darkside_abilities.py) while the fighter's Darkside is on; the Darkside command switches it off and on. Owner 2026-11-11 (after the balance pass): Rally replaces Tough hides on course 3, because the course's hidden HP factor (hp_factor, 1 on course 1 rising to 2.5 on courses 13-14) made 'enemies have 25% more HP' redundant and misleading; the ladder keeps that 25% and no rank rule names it. Rally (kind rally, buffwheel.lua): whenever an enemy falls during a round, every enemy still standing gains one random boon from enemy_boons (the Rivals pool; one it does not have yet where possible), one per fall; the last enemy's fall gives none, an enemy restored by Second wind has not fallen and a wave arriving is not a fall.
_party: Owner 2026-11-09: post-game content should use the whole party; each round should field three at random. Inside a course the game's party is only the fighters picked (live: ChangePartyMember had nobody else to bring in), so courses use the Gold Saucer's two-team mode: the player picks six (teams 2, three each). Random three of those six per round is in testing.
_bosses: Owner 2026-11-09: rounds 3, 6 and 9 are boss rounds; course 14 adds a tenth with two bosses. Courses 1-6 end on Chadley's regional legendary fiends (*_07_050 rounds): those have no fixed level and fight at the party's level (RecommendedLevel -2, shown as 'Lv Sync'), so they are a deliberate spike.
_slots:
Curated random rounds (owner design 2026-11-09): every round slot of every
course has its own pool of about ten candidate rounds, and each run draws one
from each pool. "Not utter chaos, curated randomisation": each slot's pool is
harder than the one before it, and each course's pools harder than the last
course's.
_combined: Owner 2026-11-11: rounds should be new fights, two existing rounds fought as one (tools/make_combined_rounds.py; at most 6 enemies; a pair aims at about 1.5x its slot's median round; boss rounds are the boss plus a small group of adds, never two bosses outside the encore; the encore is unchanged). share: the part of each slot's pool that is combined rounds, so a run meets one in about that share of its rounds; a course may set its own combined_share. mode new (T2, the default since 2026-11-11: live-tested on course 2 and three forced rounds of course 1, no hang) adds rows terVR_COL30_MIX_<a>_<b>; mode repurpose (T1, also live-tested) rewrites the 17 spare simulator territories (Gilgamesh quest rows excluded) and stays available with --combined-mode repurpose.
_titles: Owner 2026-11-10: ranks lowest to highest, so each course reads as a rank up; revised the same day (Rookie first, no Sergeant, Elite Grenadier above Elite Riot Officer, Nandemoyasan last). _balance: Owner 2026-11-11 (balance): the Junon Colosseum must be harder than every vanilla challenge. A round's difficulty is its enemies' HP in our arena (hp(): spec HP x EnemyParameter Enemy_<level>.HPMax / 100 at level max(listed, 67), verified live 2026-11-11; wave enemies are left out). Rules: - slots: normal rounds in 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8; boss rounds in 3, 6, 9; course 14's encore (10) fights two bosses at once. Two-boss rounds (two enemies of 1500+ base HP each, and vanilla's own two-boss rounds, ENCORE) are drawn only by the encore ("never two bosses outside the encore"); a pair of enemies of 1200+ base HP each is a boss round; a pair below that is not (GOLDA_11_010, two Elfadunk subspecies). Normal rounds too big for every normal slot (HEAVY) may be drawn by slot 9. - each slot aims at SHAPE[slot] x the course's step (STEP_FIRST on course 1 to 1 on course 14) and takes the POOL (boss) or NORMAL_POOL rounds of its kind closest to that; - no outliers: a normal slot never holds a round above the next boss slot's median; a boss slot's weakest round beats every earlier normal slot's median; the encore's weakest beats slot 9's median and slot 9 holds nothing above the encore's median; - the medians rise: normal slots in order, boss slots in order, each boss slot above its neighbours, the encore above everything; - the course's median total HP (with its HP factor) follows a smooth ramp from course 1's own total to TARGET_LAST on course 14 (about 1.3x vanilla's hardest course, Legendary "Bonds of Friendship", 1.25M at Lv70). Pools alone cannot reach it, so each course gets a hidden HP factor (course-design 'hp_factor', never below 1 and never below the course before's, in steps of FACTOR_STEP, so courses share clone sets). It is the course's whole HP change (apply_difficulty course_rules; the _JCnn spec clones carry it): owner 2026-11-11, no rank rule names it (Rally replaced Tough hides' 25%, which the ladder keeps). Rewrites courses[*].slots, bosses and hp_factor in data/course-design.json. Run tools/apply_course_design.py after (and tools/make_combined_rounds.py).
